title: Handling JSON Data with Error Checking

solution:
# Task 1: Import requests and JSONDecodeError
import requests
from requests.exceptions import JSONDecodeError

api_url = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/1'

# Task 2: Make the GET request
response = requests.get(api_url)

# Tasks 3-6: Parse JSON with error handling and process response
try:
    user_data = response.json()
    
    if response.status_code == 200:
        name = user_data['name']
        email = user_data['email']
        print(f"Name: {name}, Email: {email}")
    else:
        print(f"Request failed with status code: {response.status_code}")
        
except JSONDecodeError:
    print("Error: Invalid JSON response")

# The code below will print the status code for testing - DO NOT MODIFY
print(f"Status code: {response.status_code}")
